# blockchain-interview-questions

> 54 blockchain and smart-contract interview questions with concise answers, each linked to a runnable lab, a free tool or an explainer.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchain-interview-questions/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchain-interview-questions/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/blockchain-interview-questions/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [README.md](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchain-interview-questions/blob/main/README.md): content
